name: soulstation
source:
An atmospheric audio-visual narrative of a child who boards a train to the afterlife.

Will you give in to reality? Or crawl your way out? In this beautiful dusk, you need only open your heart.

Learn the meaning of this world, listen to the neurosis in the background radiation, and forget how to absolve yourself. Foster your comfort pain, and grieve for the last time.

Become a human, an object, or the nothing in-between, and let go. Don't forget your ticket (or your name), and you may have a chance to solve the mystery of this place and its inhabitants.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4370460/soulstation/]Steam[/url]]
